Popover

Popovers are small floating panels anchored to a trigger. They pair rich content with a non-modal presence — perfect for quick actions, help hints and inline forms.

Basic Popover

Link a trigger to its panel with data-zak-popover="#id". The popover toggles on click and closes on outside clicks or Escape.

About this project
ZAKUIKit is a modular design system that ships functional primitives with a clean API.
HTML
<div style="display:inline-block; position:relative;">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" data-zak-popover="#popoverBasic">More info</button>
    <div class="zak-popover" id="popoverBasic">
        <div class="zak-popover-header">About this project</div>
        <div class="zak-popover-body">ZAKUIKit is a modular design system.</div>
    </div>
</div>

Popover with Header

Give the popover a .zak-popover-header for a bold title, and use .zak-popover-body for supporting text.

Combine popovers with a footer of quick actions using .zak-popover-footer.

Popover with Form

Popovers can hold compact inline forms — an efficient pattern for rename, quick-edit and filter inputs.

Placements

Guide the popover with data-zak-popover-placement: top, bottom, left, or right (default bottom).

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
/* Class Summary */
.zak-popover           /* Floating panel (hidden until active) */
.zak-popover-active    /* Added by JS to show the popover */
.zak-popover-header    /* Bold title row */
.zak-popover-body      /* Main content */
.zak-popover-footer    /* Action row */

/* Variables used */
--zak-surface          /* Panel background */
--zak-border           /* Panel border */
--zak-shadow-lg        /* Floating shadow */
--zak-z-tooltip        /* Popover z-index (above content, below tooltips?) */
--zak-radius-lg        /* Rounded corners */

JavaScript

HTML
// Data attributes (automatic)
//   data-zak-popover="#id"       toggle the popover
//   data-zak-popover-close       close the closest .zak-popover
//   data-zak-popover-placement   "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right"

// Programmatic API
zak.popover.open('#myPopover');
zak.popover.close('#myPopover');
zak.popover.toggle('#myPopover');

// Options within a single call
zak.popover.open('#myPopover', {
    placement: 'top',
    trigger: 'click'     // or 'hover' / 'focus'
});

// Events on the popover element
pop.addEventListener('zak:open', function () { console.log('opened'); });
pop.addEventListener('zak:close', function () { console.log('closed'); });

Accessibility

  • Keep popovers compact — they are auxiliary by design and should never hide critical content.
  • Anchored popovers should use role="dialog" when they contain interactive controls, otherwise role="tooltip" or plain content.
  • The trigger keeps the sematic label; reflect the expanded state with aria-expanded.
  • Popovers close on outside click and Escape, and should not trap focus.
  • Avoid covering the trigger target when placing popovers with small screens; let the framework flip the placement.
